diane: Heads up - onboarding the iOS sample app hit a couple of nasty SDK vs REST gaps. The app calls a deployments list to choose a default model but the Swift SDK's generated client doesn't have the `listDeployments` binding. curl works fine.

samir: which endpoint? `GET /v1/deployments`?

diane: yup. curl returns pages and a `filters` param accepts repeated keys. Example that works:

```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
  \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deployments?filters=region:us-east&filters=hardware:A100\"
```

Using the Swift client: `client.deployments.list(filters: [\"region:us-east\",\"hardware:A100\"])` -> compile error: no `deployments` namespace. The generated bindings appear to have dropped the deployments tag (name collision with internal Deployments enum).

ci-bot: created issue IOS-212: missing deployments.list binding in swift-sdk. https://git.redwood/dev/swift-sdk/issues/212 :ticket:

mobile-relay: also noticed a parameter drift: the REST expects `filters` repeated, but the Swift serializer only supports a single comma-joined `filters=region:us-east,hardware:A100` which some proxies treat as a single filter and return nothing. That caused the onboarding list to be empty and the UI to prompt the user to retry.

diane: worse: the iOS SDK transport layer automatically retries on 5xx and network errors, but the sampleapp calls a POST to create a transient onboarding record if no deployment is found. The retry logic marks POSTs as idempotent by default (bug), so duplicate onboarding records get created when the initial request times out and retries. With the combination of missing `listDeployments` and the comma-joined filters the flow hit the POST and we saw duplicates.

samir: ouch. Do we also have header casing mismatches? we keep seeing those in other SDK reports.

diane: yes - the Swift HTTP wrapper lowercases headers when building URLRequest. On our on-prem auth plugin `Authorization` must be case-preserved; lowercased `authorization` gets ignored and yields 401. So in some installs the initial list request fails with 401, then the sampleapp falls back to create, and the retry bug duplicates the create.

ops-bot: labels applied: sdk/swift, bug, onboarding, headers, query-params, retries. Assigned to @samir.

samir: plan: 1) add a compatibility accessor in the Swift SDK `client.deployments` that wraps the generated client (avoid enum name collisions). 2) change query param array serialization default to `repeat` (filters=... repeated) and add an option to configure arrayFormat. 3) fix retry policy: POSTs must not be retried by default unless idempotency key present; make retries opt-in for non-idempotent methods. 4) preserve header casing when constructing URLRequest. 5) add integration test hitting `/v1/deployments` against staging proxy and an end-to-end onboarding scenario asserting single onboarding record created.

mobile-relay: short-term workaround for the sampleapp: call REST directly with URLComponents to build repeated `filters` and use URLSession to set header casing exactly. Add an explicit idempotency-key header for the onboarding POST so retries are safe. I'll add this to the mobile sample README.

diane: posting a tiny gist with the fallback snippet and the curl example. Thanks. This blocked a partner demo this morning.

samir: ETA: patch branch today, small patch release targeted tomorrow after CI. I'll post PR and release notes here.

diane: thanks for the quick triage :raised_hands:
